left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Men  [OR] and women over 18 years old
-  Written informed consent according to ICH / GCP and Spanish legislation, obtained before any study procedure

right.raw_text:
-  Patient with a BMI equal to or greater than 30 Kg / m2
  -  Patients with clinical  [OR] and radiological criteria of knee osteoarthritis

left.raw_text: -  Patients with indication for primary TKA according to medical criteria

right.raw_text: -  Inability to give informed consent in the absence of a legal representative

left.raw_text: -  Subjects that are participating in a study with medicines  [OR] or other medical devices
-  Those who show inability to follow the instructions or collaborate during the development of the study

right.raw_text:
-  If in the opinion of the researcher there are findings in the physical examination, [OR]  abnormalities  [OR] in the results of the clinical analyzes or other medical, social  [OR] or psychosocial factors that could have a negative influence
  -  Having had a previous surgical procedure on  [OR] or around the knee in the last 12 months (such as proximal tibial osteotomy, [OR]  femoral osteotomy, [OR]  open reduction  [OR] and internal fixation for a fracture, [OR]  patellectomy  [OR] or patellar realignment)

left.raw_text: -  Have a varus angle  [OR] or valgus ≥ 15 °
